note: XXVII fills B: the by-road, the night of the circle, the race at sunset · Booth style · no moon
style: An oil painting in colour of 1893 with the drama of Franklin Booth: monumental scale, deep recession, towering forms, strong value contrast and deep shadow, light breaking through haze, a sense of awe. Loose visible brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges. Cold early-November light in the Carpathians, snow. No moon in any sky. Any face is small and unreadable. No text, signature or border.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. A faint neglected track lightly covered in snow winding up through a high Carpathian valley in November 1893, the horses of a small carriage picking their own way, no clear road, pines and crags.

Shot: far. A carriage halted on a snowy mountain road in the afternoon, a woman asleep under heavy rugs inside it, small and still, an elderly man standing beside the horses looking at her, low sun, long blue shadows.
Shot: wide, no people. Dawn on 5 November 1893 high in the Carpathians: the embers of a fire smouldering in a ring in the snow, rugs, a carriage beyond, the first cold light on the peaks.
Shot: wide. Night in the snow below a ruined castle: two horses rearing and tearing at their tethers in terror beside a carriage, lit by the red glow of a fire, snow swirling in the dark, no moon.

Shot: very wide. Night on a snowy hillside: the snow swirling and gathering into tall pale wreaths and half-shapes like women in long garments, circling a small fire in a ring, dark ruined castle above, no moon.
Shot: close, no people. A dying fire in the snow at night, low red embers, a ring traced around it with white crumbs scattered along the line, swirling snow beyond the ring that does not cross it.

Shot: very wide. The ruined castle on its crag above a snowy valley at sunset on 6 November 1893, its towers lit red by the last sun, long blue shadows on the snow, a road winding below with a tiny cart and riders on it.

Shot: medium-wide. Silhouettes at sunset on a snowy road in 1893: two men in long coats raising Winchester rifles, their faces unseen, a band of red sky and the low sun behind them, a cart and horsemen beyond.
